/scripts.value:
command queryReport
	local tDataA, tAdvancedMap, tOutputA, tStart, tEnd
	local tCurrentRecordA, tQuizID, tQuizName, tReportA
	local tScore, tCompletion, tQuizTotalsA, tCount, tDate, tGroupKey
	local tCompletedCount, tStudentRecordID, tStudentName, tSelectedQuizliID
	local tStudentID, tStudentReportsA, tSessionID, tCurrentAnswerA
	local tQuestionText, tQuestionNumber, tResult, tSubmission, tSelectedAnswerText
	local tNumberOfQuestions, tNumberOfQuestionsAnswered
	
	if selectedStudentSelectedReport is not empty then
		put selectedStudentReportsA[selectedStudentSelectedReport]["sessionID"] into tSessionID
		put cdb_query("sessionID", "=", tSessionID, authedUserStudentAnswersTable, "local", "recordData") into tOutputA
		if tOutputA is not empty then
			repeat for each key xAnswerID in tOutputA
				put tOutputA[xAnswerID] into tCurrentAnswerA
				put tOutputA[xAnswerID]["questionText"] into tQuestionText
				put tOutputA[xAnswerID]["questionNumber"] into tQuestionNumber
				put tOutputA[xAnswerID]["rubricScore"] into tScore
				put tOutputA[xAnswerID]["isCorrect"] into tResult
				switch tResult
					case "True"
						put "Correct" into tResult
						break
					
					case "False"
						put "Incorrect" into tResult
						break
				end switch
				put tOutputA[xAnswerID]["selectedAnswer"] into tSubmission
				
				if tSubmission is empty then
					put tOutputA[xAnswerID]["freeResponseText"] into tSubmission
					put tSubmission into tReportA[xAnswerID]["submission"]
				else
					if tSubmission is among the words of "A B C D" then
						put tOutputA[xAnswerID]["selectedAnswerText"] into tSelectedAnswerText
						put tSubmission & ":" && tSelectedAnswerText into tReportA[xAnswerID]["submission"]
					else
						put tSubmission into tReportA[xAnswerID]["submission"]
					end if
				end if
				
				put "Question" && tQuestionNumber & ":" && tQuestionText into tReportA[xAnswerID]["questionText"]
				put tQuestionNumber into tReportA[xAnswerID]["questionNumber"]
				put tScore into tReportA[xAnswerID]["points"]
				put tResult into tReportA[xAnswerID]["result"]
			end repeat
		end if
		put tReportA into selectedStudentResultsA
		exit queryReport
	end if
	
	//if selectedReportType is "Class Reports" then
	if selectedReportClass is not empty then
		put "classID" into tDataA["classID"]["key"]
		put "=" into tDataA["classID"]["operator"]
		put selectedReportClass into tDataA["classID"]["value"]
		if tAdvancedMap is empty then
			put "classID" into tAdvancedMap
		else
			put " and classID" after tAdvancedMap
		end if
	end if
	
	switch
		case selectedReportStartDate is empty and selectedReportEndDate is empty
			break
		
		case selectedReportStartDate is not empty and selectedReportEndDate is not empty
			put "cdbDateCreated" into tDataA["startDate"]["key"]
			put "date>=" into tDataA["startDate"]["operator"]
			put selectedReportStartDate into tStart
			convert tStart to seconds
			put tStart into tDataA["startDate"]["value"]
			
			put "cdbDateCreated" into tDataA["endDate"]["key"]
			put "date<=" into tDataA["endDate"]["operator"]
			put selectedReportEndDate into tEnd
			convert tEnd to seconds
			add 86400 to tEnd
			put tEnd into tDataA["endDate"]["value"]
			
			if tAdvancedMap is empty then
				put "(startDate and endDate)" into tAdvancedMap
			else
				put " and (startDate and endDate)" after tAdvancedMap
			end if
			break
		
		case selectedReportStartDate is not empty and selectedReportEndDate is empty
			put "cdbDateCreated" into tDataA["startDate"]["key"]
			put "date>=" into tDataA["startDate"]["operator"]
			put selectedReportStartDate into tStart
			convert tStart to seconds
			put tStart into tDataA["startDate"]["value"]
			
			put "cdbDateCreated" into tDataA["endDate"]["key"]
			put "date<=" into tDataA["endDate"]["operator"]
			put selectedReportStartDate into tEnd
			convert tEnd to seconds
			add 86400 to tEnd
			put tEnd into tDataA["endDate"]["value"]
			
			if tAdvancedMap is empty then
				put "(startDate and endDate)" into tAdvancedMap
			else
				put " and (startDate and endDate)" after tAdvancedMap
			end if
			break
		
		case selectedReportStartDate is empty and selectedReportEndDate is not empty
			put "cdbDateCreated" into tDataA["startDate"]["key"]
			put "date>=" into tDataA["startDate"]["operator"]
			put selectedReportEndDate into tStart
			convert tStart to seconds
			put tStart into tDataA["startDate"]["value"]
			
			put "cdbDateCreated" into tDataA["endDate"]["key"]
			put "date<=" into tDataA["endDate"]["operator"]
			put selectedReportEndDate into tEnd
			convert tEnd to seconds
			add 86400 to tEnd
			put tEnd into tDataA["endDate"]["value"]
			
			if tAdvancedMap is empty then
				put "(startDate and endDate)" into tAdvancedMap
			else
				put " and (startDate and endDate)" after tAdvancedMap
			end if
			break
	end switch
	
	put "teacherID" into tDataA["teacherID"]["key"]
	put "=" into tDataA["teacherID"]["operator"]
	put authedUserID into tDataA["teacherID"]["value"]
	if tAdvancedMap is empty then
		put "teacherID" into tAdvancedMap
	else
		put " and teacherID" after tAdvancedMap
	end if
	
	if tDataA is not empty then
		put cdb_advancedQuery(tDataA,tAdvancedMap,"Report1","local","recordData") into tOutputA
		
		if tOutputA is not empty then
			if selectedReportType is "Class Reports" then
				if selectedQuizliReport is empty then
					repeat for each key xReportID in tOutputA
						put tOutputA[xReportID] into tCurrentRecordA
						
						put tCurrentRecordA["QuizID"] into tQuizID
						put tCurrentRecordA["QuizName"] into tQuizName
						put tCurrentRecordA["cdb"]["cdbDateCreated"] into tDate
						convert tDate to date
						replace "/" with "-" in tDate
						put tQuizID & ":" & tDate into tGroupKey
						replace "-" with "/" in tDate
						put tQuizName into tQuizTotalsA[tGroupKey]["quizName"]
						put tDate into tQuizTotalsA[tGroupKey]["date"]
						
						put tCurrentRecordA["Score"] into tScore
						if tScore is "0/0" then
							 put 0 into tScore
						else
							put value(tScore) into tScore
						 end if
						 add tScore to tQuizTotalsA[tGroupKey]["scoreTotal"]					
						
						put tCurrentRecordA["Completion"] into tCompletion
						replace "%" with empty in tCompletion
						if tCompletion = 100 then
							 add 1 to tQuizTotalsA[tGroupKey]["completedCount"]
						 end if
						
						add 1 to tQuizTotalsA[tGroupKey]["count"]
					end repeat
					
					repeat for each key xGroupKey in tQuizTotalsA
						put tQuizTotalsA[xGroupKey]["quizName"] into tReportA[xGroupKey]["quizName"]
						put tQuizTotalsA[xGroupKey]["date"] into tReportA[xGroupKey]["date"]
						put tQuizTotalsA[xGroupKey]["completedCount"] into tCompletedCount
						if tCompletedCount is empty then
							put 0 into tCompletedCount
						end if
						put tCompletedCount & "/" & tQuizTotalsA[xGroupKey]["count"] into tReportA[xGroupKey]["completion"]
						put round((tQuizTotalsA[xGroupKey]["scoreTotal"] / tQuizTotalsA[xGroupKey]["count"]) * 100) & "%" into tReportA[xGroupKey]["score"]
					end repeat
					put tReportA into reportSearchQuizliA
				else
					set the itemdel to ":"
					put item 1 of selectedQuizliReport into tSelectedQuizliID
					set the itemdel to comma
					repeat for each key xReportID in tOutputA
						put tOutputA[xReportID] into tCurrentRecordA
						
						put tCurrentRecordA["QuizID"] into tQuizID
						if tQuizID is not tSelectedQuizliID then
							next repeat
						end if
						
						put tCurrentRecordA["QuizName"] into tQuizName
						put tCurrentRecordA["StudentRecordID"] into tStudentRecordID
						put tCurrentRecordA["StudentName"] into tStudentName
						put tCurrentRecordA["cdb"]["cdbDateCreated"] into tDate
						convert tDate to date
						if tStudentRecordID is empty then
							put "guest" & ":" & tStudentName & ":" & xReportID into tGroupKey
						else
							put tStudentRecordID & ":" & xReportID into tGroupKey
						end if
						
						put tStudentName into tReportA[tGroupKey]["studentName"]
						put tQuizName into tReportA[tGroupKey]["quizName"]
						put tDate into tReportA[tGroupKey]["date"]
						
						put tCurrentRecordA["Score"] into tScore
						if tScore is "0/0" then
							 put 0 into tScore
						else
							put round(value(tScore) * 100) into tScore
						 end if
						 put tScore & "%" into tReportA[tGroupKey]["score"]					
						
						put tCurrentRecordA["Completion"] into tCompletion
						 put tCompletion into tReportA[tGroupKey]["completion"]
					end repeat
					put tReportA into selectedQuizliReportA
				end if
			else if selectedReportType is "Student Reports" then
				repeat for each key xReportID in tOutputA
					put tOutputA[xReportID] into tCurrentRecordA
					put tCurrentRecordA["StudentRecordID"] into tStudentRecordID
					if tStudentRecordID is empty then
						put tCurrentRecordA["StudentID"] into tStudentID
						put tCurrentRecordA["StudentName"] into tStudentName
						put tStudentID & ":" & tStudentName into tStudentRecordID
					end if
					put tCurrentRecordA["cdb"]["cdbDateCreated"] into tDate
					convert tDate to date
					put tDate into tCurrentRecordA["date"]
					put tCurrentRecordA into tReportA[tStudentRecordID]
					put tCurrentRecordA into tStudentReportsA[tStudentRecordID][xReportID]
				end repeat
				
				if selectedReportStudent is empty then
					put tReportA into reportSearchStudentA
				else
					repeat for each key xReportID in tStudentReportsA[selectedReportStudent]
						put tStudentReportsA[selectedReportStudent][xReportID] into tCurrentRecordA
						put tCurrentRecordA["NumberofQuestions"] into tNumberOfQuestions
						put tCurrentRecordA["NumberofQuestionsAnswered"] into tNumberOfQuestionsAnswered
						if tNumberOfQuestions is not empty and tNumberOfQuestions is not 0 then
							if tNumberOfQuestionsAnswered is empty or tNumberOfQuestionsAnswered is 0 then
								put "0/" & tNumberOfQuestions into tStudentReportsA[selectedReportStudent][xReportID]["completionFraction"]
							else
								put tNumberOfQuestionsAnswered & "/" & tNumberOfQuestions into tStudentReportsA[selectedReportStudent][xReportID]["completionFraction"]
							end if
						else
							put "0/0" into tStudentReportsA[selectedReportStudent][xReportID]["completionFraction"]
						end if
						put tCurrentRecordA["Score"] into tScore
						if tScore is "0/0" then
							 put 0 into tScore
						else
							put round(value(tScore) * 100) into tScore
						 end if
						 put tScore & "%" into tStudentReportsA[selectedReportStudent][xReportID]["ScorePercent"]
					end repeat			
					put tStudentReportsA[selectedReportStudent] into selectedStudentReportsA
				end if
			end if
		end if
	end if
//end if

exit queryReport
//----------------------------------------------------------------------------------
//OLD REPORTS (KEEPING IN CASE WE NEED IT IN THE FUTURE)
if selectedReportType is "Class Reports" then
	if selectedReportQuizli is not empty then
		put "quizID" into tDataA["quizID"]["key"]
		put "=" into tDataA["quizID"]["operator"]
		put selectedReportQuizli into tDataA["quizID"]["value"]
		put "quizID" into tAdvancedMap
	end if
end if

if selectedReportType is "Student Reports" then
	if selectedReportStudent is not empty then
		put "studentRecordID" into tDataA["studentRecordID"]["key"]
		put "=" into tDataA["studentRecordID"]["operator"]
		put selectedReportStudent into tDataA["studentRecordID"]["value"]
		put "studentRecordID" into tAdvancedMap
	end if
end if

if selectedReportType is not "Student Reports" then
	if selectedReportClass is not empty then
		put "classID" into tDataA["classID"]["key"]
		put "=" into tDataA["classID"]["operator"]
		put selectedReportClass into tDataA["classID"]["value"]
		if tAdvancedMap is empty then
			put "classID" into tAdvancedMap
		else
			put " and classID" after tAdvancedMap
		end if
	end if
end if

if selectedReportGradeLevel is not empty then
	put "gradeLevel" into tDataA["gradeLevel"]["key"]
	put "=" into tDataA["gradeLevel"]["operator"]
	put selectedReportGradeLevel into tDataA["gradeLevel"]["value"]
	if tAdvancedMap is empty then
		put "gradeLevel" into tAdvancedMap
	else
		put " and gradeLevel" after tAdvancedMap
	end if
end if

switch
	case selectedReportStartDate is empty and selectedReportEndDate is empty
		break
	
	case selectedReportStartDate is not empty and selectedReportEndDate is not empty
		put "cdbDateCreated" into tDataA["startDate"]["key"]
		put "date>=" into tDataA["startDate"]["operator"]
		put selectedReportStartDate into tStart
		convert tStart to seconds
		put tStart into tDataA["startDate"]["value"]
		
		put "cdbDateCreated" into tDataA["endDate"]["key"]
		put "date<=" into tDataA["endDate"]["operator"]
		put selectedReportEndDate into tEnd
		convert tEnd to seconds
		add 86400 to tEnd
		put tEnd into tDataA["endDate"]["value"]
		
		if tAdvancedMap is empty then
			put "startDate and endDate" into tAdvancedMap
		else
			put " and (startDate and endDate)" after tAdvancedMap
		end if
		break
	
	case selectedReportStartDate is not empty and selectedReportEndDate is empty
		put "cdbDateCreated" into tDataA["startDate"]["key"]
		put "date>=" into tDataA["startDate"]["operator"]
		put selectedReportStartDate into tStart
		convert tStart to seconds
		put tStart into tDataA["startDate"]["value"]
		
		put "cdbDateCreated" into tDataA["endDate"]["key"]
		put "date<=" into tDataA["endDate"]["operator"]
		put selectedReportStartDate into tEnd
		convert tEnd to seconds
		add 86400 to tEnd
		put tEnd into tDataA["endDate"]["value"]
		
		if tAdvancedMap is empty then
			put "startDate and endDate" into tAdvancedMap
		else
			put " and (startDate and endDate)" after tAdvancedMap
		end if
		break
	
	case selectedReportStartDate is empty and selectedReportEndDate is not empty
		put "cdbDateCreated" into tDataA["startDate"]["key"]
		put "date>=" into tDataA["startDate"]["operator"]
		put selectedReportEndDate into tStart
		convert tStart to seconds
		put tStart into tDataA["startDate"]["value"]
		
		put "cdbDateCreated" into tDataA["endDate"]["key"]
		put "date<=" into tDataA["endDate"]["operator"]
		put selectedReportEndDate into tEnd
		convert tEnd to seconds
		add 86400 to tEnd
		put tEnd into tDataA["endDate"]["value"]
		
		if tAdvancedMap is empty then
			put "startDate and endDate" into tAdvancedMap
		else
			put " and (startDate and endDate)" after tAdvancedMap
		end if
		break
end switch

put "teacherID" into tDataA["teacherID"]["key"]
put "=" into tDataA["teacherID"]["operator"]
put authedUserID into tDataA["teacherID"]["value"]
if tAdvancedMap is empty then
	put "teacherID" into tAdvancedMap
else
	put " and teacherID" after tAdvancedMap
end if

if tDataA is not empty then
	put cdb_advancedQuery(tDataA,tAdvancedMap,"Report1","local","recordList") into tOutputA
end if
put tOutputA into reportRecordIDs
end queryReport
